entities.name: 5GMM common procedures
entities.description: Network-initiated procedures including identification, authentication, and security procedures during registration.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which 5GMM common procedures may be initiated by the network.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message received by network that may trigger initiation of 5GMM common procedures.

entities.name: NAS security mode control procedure
entities.description: Security procedure that may be initiated as part of 5GMM common procedures.

entities.name: 5GS registration type IE
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of registration procedure.

entities.name: Emergency registration condition
entities.description: Condition where 5GS registration type IE is set to emergency registration.

entities.name: Skip authentication procedure
entities.description: AMF behavior to bypass authentication when configured for emergency registration with unauthenticated SUCIs.

relations.description: 5GMM common procedures are initiated during registration procedure.
Network initiates 5GMM common procedures based on information in REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
NAS security mode control procedure is part of 5GMM common procedures.
5GS registration type IE being set to emergency registration creates the emergency registration condition.
Emergency registration condition enables AMF to skip authentication procedure.
